svg.title: New profiles close the seam; old stores stay explicit
svg.desc: Baseline reproduction against clean 3b34e00 confirms the old acknowledgment/relay NOT_AVAILABLE, 16 pending then append 17 OVERLOADED, and persistent stale-feedback CONFLICT after reopen. Those expected gaps are separate from the passing baseline regression. New-profile delivery drains, including after deduction and for model-inapplicable reports. Neither this extension nor the presentation migrates existing state. Compatibility tests populate old stores, operate on disposable copies, reject new selection without modifying bytes and replay with original descriptors. Fresh profiles preserve strict time and causal semantics. This distinction must survive any claim that the seam is now closed.
svg.text: New profiles close the seam; old stores stay explicit
The M3 findings were reproduced before edits. M3.1 is an opt-in contract extension.
C1 expects a closed v2 acknowledgment.
Relay validates C2; C1 gets narrow
C4 tracks closure separately from execution.
Populated old stores → new selection: UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE
Disposable copies reject without modification and still replay under the original profile. User stores are untouched.
No automatic conversion, repair of pre-existing pending work, invented acknowledgment or weakened validation.
